ranking_metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over all releases
selection: JCodec 0.2.5 (76), MP3SPI 1.9.5.4 (55) and JLayer 1.0.1 (33) have comparable summed deps.dev direct dependents, exact two-control Layer III PCM results, own Java source-line coverage and stable parser-derived AFL++ feedback. MP3SPI also covers its soundlibs JLayer decoder separately and shares the original JLayer decoder lineage.
family_note: JCodec is independent of JLayer. MP3SPI has its own Java Sound reader/conversion path but delegates decoding to soundlibs JLayer, a fork of the selected javazoom:jlayer lineage; these are distinct package/API paths, not three independent decoder families.
uncertainty: Three pure-Java Layer III paths verified; no padding. Maven Central phrase queries returned no hits, so named leads were inspected via deps.dev and package documentation. deps.dev counts whole-package dependency use, not MP3-specific calls. Two untagged CBR controls do not establish VBR, Xing/Info, free-format, Layer I/II, MPEG-2.5 or ID3 behavior. Java SE 25 exports no MP3 reader by inventory.
